question: How are will and action identified with the powers of śakti?
premises: Will can be attributed to śakti.
Action can be attributed to śakti.
Will and action are identified with śakti's powers.
inference: Will is the will of śakti, and action is the action of śakti.
plain_english: Will would be the will of śakti, and action would be the action of śakti.
